materials.title: Cognitive household labor: gender disparities and consequences for maternal mental health and wellbeing
materials.observed_at_missing_reason: The exact UTC moment of the earlier direct page review was not captured; no timestamp is inferred.
verified_claims: Study surveyed 322 mothers of young children about 30 household tasks.
Self-reported cognitive/planning labor was more disproportionately divided than execution labor.
Cognitive labor was associated with depression, stress, burnout, mental health, and relationship functioning measures.
limits: US sample of mothers with young children; self-report.
Associations do not establish causality or universal family patterns.
materials.rights: One public article read for source-checking; no bulk collection.

materials.title: Less cash, more splash? A meta-analysis on the cashless effect
materials.observed_at_missing_reason: The exact UTC moment of the earlier publisher/index record review was not captured; no timestamp is inferred.
verified_claims: 2024 meta-analysis combined 71 papers and 392 effect sizes.
The aggregate cashless effect on spending was small and statistically significant.
The aggregate effect weakened over time; included cashless methods were not limited to QR.
limits: Sources surfaced the publisher abstract/record; not every included study was reviewed.
Do not infer that each person always spends more cashlessly or that QR alone caused the effect.
Publisher page displayed an automated access challenge; no challenge was bypassed.
materials.rights: Read one public abstract/record for source-checking; no bulk collection.

materials.title: 湖南新田：民间借贷纠纷背后挖出诈骗案
materials.observed_at_missing_reason: Earlier direct visible page review time was not preserved to the second; no time is inferred.
verified_claims: Official SPP report describes one Xin'tian, Hunan case in which Xie used a bridge-loan pretext to obtain more than RMB 7 million from seven friends/relatives.
Investigators/prosecutors found project construction contract and IOUs were forged; report says funds went to online gambling and virtual-currency transactions.
Report says the first-instance judgment on 2024-01-12 convicted fraud and imposed 13 years 6 months and RMB 200,000 fine.
limits: One reported case; no inference about ordinary friend/family lending.
Use paraphrase rather than reconstruct a quotation from a partial description.
Sentence is described as the first-instance judgment reported in 2024.
materials.rights: One public government report read for source-checking; no bulk collection.

materials.title: Keeping Up With Work Email After Hours and Employee Wellbeing: The Role of Work-Family Border Control, Psychological Detachment and Work-Related Rumination
materials.observed_at_missing_reason: The exact UTC moment of the earlier direct page review was not captured; no timestamp is inferred.
verified_claims: Sample included 173 full-time US administrative assistants who were required to work from home during COVID.
Nonwork-hours work email was associated with reduced psychological detachment and work-family conflict.
Telepressure moderated the relationship between after-hours work email and psychological detachment.
limits: Cross-sectional/self-report and narrow occupational sample; no causal claim.
The moderation statement here refers to the email-detachment relationship, not a stronger relation to every outcome.
Do not generalize to all workers or describe actual instant replies as observed behavior.
materials.rights: One public article record/abstract and methods read for source-checking; no bulk collection.

materials.title: Can unhealthy food purchases at checkout be discouraged by introducing healthier snacks? A real-life experiment in supermarkets in deprived urban areas
materials.observed_at_missing_reason: The exact UTC moment of the earlier direct page review was not captured; no timestamp is inferred.
verified_claims: Twenty-four Dutch supermarkets participated: 15 intervention stores and 9 control stores.
Unhealthy snack purchases showed no statistically significant between-group difference in change.
At three intervention stores, 134 respondents were surveyed; 41% noticed the adjustment and 80% of those noticing it reported being satisfied/very satisfied.
limits: The store comparison is not described as a randomized trial.
Nonsignificant difference does not establish exactly no effect.
The survey was only at three intervention stores; 80% denominator is respondents noticing the change.
materials.rights: One public article record/abstract read for source-checking; no bulk collection.
